cleanser.title: Gentle Cleanser
cleanser.instructions: Massage onto damp skin for 30 seconds, then rinse with lukewarm water.

toner.title: Rose Water Revitalize
toner.instructions: Apply 3-4 sprays or use a cotton pad. This balances your pH levels and prepares your skin to absorb serums more effectively.

serum.title: Brightening Core
serum.instructions: Press 2-3 drops into skin, avoiding the eye area. Follow with moisturizer.

eye.title: Caffeine Eye Gel
eye.instructions: Dab gently along the orbital bone using your ring finger.

moisturizer.title: Barrier Repair Cream
moisturizer.instructions: Warm a coin-sized amount between palms and press into skin.

spf.title: SPF 50+ Shield
spf.instructions: Apply generously as the final step, 15 minutes before sun exposure.

pm_cleanse.title: Cleansing Balm + Gel
pm_cleanse.instructions: Melt the balm over dry skin to lift SPF and makeup, emulsify with water, then follow with your gentle gel cleanser.

pm_toner.title: Calming Essence
pm_toner.instructions: Pat a few drops into slightly damp skin to replenish hydration after cleansing.

pm_treatment.title: Retinol Renewal Serum
pm_treatment.instructions: Apply a pea-sized amount to dry skin, avoiding the eyes and corners of the nose. Start 2-3 nights a week.

pm_eye.title: Peptide Eye Cream
pm_eye.instructions: Tap a rice-grain amount along the orbital bone with your ring finger.

pm_night_cream.title: Overnight Recovery Cream
pm_night_cream.instructions: Seal everything in with a generous layer, pressing it gently into cheeks, forehead and neck.

s1.title: 1. Accepting these terms
s1.p1: By creating an account or using MyFace AI ("the app"), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.
s1.p2: If you are under 18, you may use the app only with the permission of a parent or guardian, who agrees to these terms on your behalf. Teenage Mode in Settings offers extra protections for younger users.

s2.title: 2. Cosmetic guidance only — not medical advice
s2.p1: Face scans, scores, routines, coach messages and product or ingredient suggestions are for general cosmetic and wellness purposes only. They are not a medical diagnosis, treatment or professional advice.
s2.p2: AI analysis can be wrong. Always patch-test new products, and see a dermatologist or doctor about any skin, hair or health concern, reaction or allergy.

s3.title: 3. Your account
s3.p1: Give accurate information when you sign up and keep your password private. You are responsible for activity on your account.
s3.p2: You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Privacy Settings. Deleting it removes your profile, scans and other saved data.

s4.title: 4. Photos and AI processing
s4.p1: When you take a face scan or use a photo tool, your photo is sent securely to our servers and to our AI provider (OpenAI) to produce the analysis. Scan results are saved to your account so you can track progress.
s4.p2: Only upload photos of yourself, or of people who have agreed to it. Do not upload images of anyone under 18 other than yourself.

s5.title: 5. Community and content you share
s5.p1: You keep ownership of the posts, photos and comments you share. You give us permission to store and display them in the app so the features work.
s5.p2: Do not post anything illegal, hateful, harassing, sexually explicit, or that infringes someone else's rights. We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these rules.

s6.title: 6. Points and rewards
s6.p1: Points, streaks, levels and referral rewards have no cash value and cannot be sold or transferred. We may adjust or remove points earned through misuse, such as fake referrals.

s7.title: 7. Acceptable use
s7.p1: Do not misuse the app — for example by trying to access other people's accounts or data, disrupting the service, or copying or reverse-engineering it.

s8.title: 8. Changes and availability
s8.p1: We may update the app and these terms. If we make important changes we will let you know in the app; continuing to use it means you accept the updated terms.
s8.p2: We work to keep the app running but cannot promise it will always be available or error-free.

s9.title: 9. Limitation of liability
s9.p1: To the extent allowed by law, the app is provided "as is", and we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for any reaction to products or routines you choose to use.
